recognize_zh: 九格骨髓抹片中都是體積極大的組織球，細胞核小而圓、常偏位，細胞質蒼白並充滿大小不一的細小透明空泡，呈泡沫或肥皂泡樣（foam cell），部分可見少量藍紫色顆粒，符合 Niemann-Pick 病的泡沫細胞。
features: Very large histiocytes (many times the diameter of a red cell) with low N:C ratio
Small, round, often eccentric nucleus with condensed chromatin
Abundant pale cytoplasm filled with numerous small uniform clear vacuoles giving a foamy/soap-bubble appearance
Scattered fine blue-violet granules/debris within some cells (possible sea-blue component)
Fragile cell borders with smudging; surrounding normal hematopoietic cells and erythrocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show numerous very large histiocytes with small round, eccentric nuclei and abundant pale cytoplasm distended by innumerable small, fairly uniform clear vacuoles, producing a foamy, soap-bubble appearance; a few cells contain scattered blue-violet granular material. Background hematopoietic elements are present. The findings are consistent with lipid-laden foam cells of a lysosomal storage disorder and, in the clinical context, support Niemann-Pick disease; confirmation by acid sphingomyelinase enzyme assay (SMPD1) or NPC1/NPC2 testing is required.

ddx.vs: Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'crumpled tissue paper' cytoplasm rather than discrete clear vacuoles and are strongly PAS-positive and tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase positive.
Sea-blue histiocytes contain prominent blue-green granules with Giemsa stain rather than predominantly clear foamy vacuoles, though overlap exists in Niemann-Pick and chronic storage.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher/foamy macrophages in high cell turnover (CML, thalassemia, hyperlipidemia)
ddx.vs: Secondary foamy histiocytes are fewer and occur with evidence of the underlying disorder, and enzyme assays are normal.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with atypical nuclei and nucleoli and are keratin-positive, unlike single bland histiocytes with small round nuclei.
